newsitem.title: UK: CDC invests in Dominican Republic, Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: CDC invests in Dominican Republic, Vietnam.

text.p: The Commonwealth Development Corporation (CDC), Britain's overseas development finance institution, has made its first investment in Vietnam via a loan to finance a sugar refinery.

The Sucrerie Bourbon de Tay Ninh is the first large scale refinery in Vietnam and is a joint venture between Groupe Societes de Bourbon of Reunion and Vietnamese organisations Tanisugar and Vinasugar II.
CDC is providing a $15 million loan repayable over eight years to the $95 million project.

In the Dominican Republic CDC has signed for the acquisition under the privatisation programme of a majority shareholding in Dominica Electricity Services Ltd, the country's sole electricity supplier.
CDC will invest up to $19 million in the initial phase of a programme to increase generation capacity and rehabilitate the transmission and distribution system.
